notes.subject: bel he
notes.rationale: אף literally 'nose/nostril' — anger flares through the nostrils in Hebrew idiom.

notes.subject: olsem bikpela wara i kamap namal
notes.rationale: שטף is a flood/overflow, rendered as flood-of-water image.

notes.subject: husat i inap sanap
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question draws the reader in: who can stand before jealousy?

translation: Kros i strok tru, na bel he i olsem bikpela wara i kamap namal, tasol husat i inap sanap pastaim long man i gat pul long bel?
